source_brief.target_audience: Self-directed retail traders, comfortable with charts, sensitive to fees

plan.campaign_summary: Highlight the unnecessary fees in ETP trades to emphasize potential savings and empower traders to make informed decisions.

concepts.name: Fee Shadows
concepts.strategic_idea: Visualize hidden fees as shadows to highlight their impact.

visual_direction.description: A chart with deceptive shadows representing hidden fees, giving a sense of uncovering a secret.

copy_package.headline: See the Fees Lurking in Your Trades
copy_package.subheadline: Discover how much you can save by trading smart.
copy_package.disclaimer: Caution. Investing involves risk of loss. Third party fees and Terms & conditions apply.
alternative_headlines: Reveal the True Cost of Your Trades

midjourney_prompt_pack.prompt_text: A financial chart with exaggerated shadowy elements emerging from the graph lines, representing hidden fees, in a clean white and navy color scheme, no logos, no UI text, no readable text, no watermark

concepts.name: Break the Chain
concepts.strategic_idea: Metaphorically break chains of high fees trapping traders.

visual_direction.description: Chains breaking around a glowing ETF, symbolizing freedom from fees.

copy_package.headline: Break Free from Excessive Fees
copy_package.subheadline: Empower your trades with lower costs.
copy_package.disclaimer: Caution. Investing involves risk of loss. Third party fees and Terms & conditions apply.
alternative_headlines: Smash the Chains of High Fees

midjourney_prompt_pack.prompt_text: A glowing exchange-traded product breaking free from chains, surrounded by a bright, liberating light source, no logos, no UI text, no readable text, no watermark
midjourney_prompt_pack.notes: Focus on the moment of breaking free.
